cohort: 312,081 women in Alberta, Canada with 1 live birth event per woman
finding: Pregnant women with rheumatoid arthritis have a higher risk of preterm delivery, Cesarean delivery, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, and SGA babies compared to pregnant women with spondyloarthritis or no inflammatory arthritis.
mod_finding: Women with RA were significantly more likely to have a Cesarean delivery compared to women with no IA, while no difference was found between women with SpA and those with no IA.
